processing: SRTM GL1 tiles S04W080, S04W079, S03W080, S03W079 mosaicked
reprojected to EPSG:32717 30 m lattice (multiples of 30 m), method: bilinear
pysheds 0.5: fill_pits, fill_depressions, resolve_flats (numpy 2.4 shim: np.in1d -> np.isin)
D8 flow direction (O'Callaghan & Mark 1984; Jenson & Domingue 1988), flow accumulation
routing on the DEM with OSM way 468343174 (Rio Buenavista) burned 10 m deep, so lowland flow follows the mapped river
upslope area = accumulated cells x 900 m2 on the burned routing surface, computed on the whole search box, clipped to the farm grid
provenance.notes: D8 upslope contributing area (m2) per cell, input for TWI (data-scientist, T-020).
